description: Automated job-hunt pipeline for Claude Code (scrape -> score -> tailor -> notify)

script: Write-Host 'Installing jobpilot-ai via pipx (recommended isolated install)...'

notes: The 'jobpilot' command is provided by pipx. Ensure the pipx bin dir is on PATH:
python -m pipx ensurepath   (then restart the terminal)
